biorxiv.name: bioRxiv
biorxiv.full_name: bioRxiv - The Preprint Server for Biology
biorxiv.description: Free online archive and distribution service for unpublished preprints in the life sciences.

medrxiv.name: medRxiv
medrxiv.full_name: medRxiv - The Preprint Server for Health Sciences
medrxiv.description: Free online archive and distribution server for complete but unpublished manuscripts (preprints) in the medical, clinical, and related health sciences.

bioinformatics.name: Bioinformatics
bioinformatics.description: Computational molecular biology covering new algorithms, software, databases, and analyses of biological data.

nucleic_acids_research.name: Nucleic Acids Research
nucleic_acids_research.description: Leading research in nucleic acids, including their chemistry, biology, and applications, and computational and structural studies of nucleic acids and their interactions.

arxiv.name: arXiv
arxiv.full_name: arXiv - Open-access archive for scholarly articles
arxiv.description: Free distribution service and open-access archive for preprints in physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, and more.

nature.name: Nature
nature.full_name: Nature - International weekly journal of science
nature.description: Weekly multidisciplinary journal publishing peer-reviewed research of outstanding significance across all fields of science and technology, alongside news and commentary.

nature_biotech.name: Nature Biotechnology
nature_biotech.description: Publishes peer-reviewed research and analysis on the science and business of biotechnology, covering the application of biological systems to therapeutics, diagnostics, agriculture, and related areas.

nature_methods.name: Nature Methods
nature_methods.description: Publishes peer-reviewed novel methods and significant improvements to techniques across the life sciences, including their development, validation, and application.

cell.name: Cell
cell.description: Cell Press flagship journal publishing high-impact peer-reviewed research across the full breadth of the life sciences.

cell_systems.name: Cell Systems
cell_systems.description: Cell Press journal publishing research in systems biology, including quantitative, computational, and theoretical approaches to understanding biological systems across scales.

cell_genomics.name: Cell Genomics
cell_genomics.description: Open-access Cell Press journal publishing research across genetics and genomics, including functional, evolutionary, and computational genomics and their applications to health and disease.

plos_compbio.name: PLOS Computational Biology
plos_compbio.description: Open-access journal publishing research that applies computational methods to understand living systems across all scales, from molecules to ecosystems.

genome_biology.name: Genome Biology
genome_biology.description: Open-access journal publishing peer-reviewed research and methods across all areas of biology and biomedicine studied from a genomic and post-genomic perspective.

bmc_bioinformatics.name: BMC Bioinformatics
bmc_bioinformatics.description: BMC Bioinformatics is an open access, peer-reviewed journal that considers articles describing novel computational algorithms and software, models and tools, including statistical methods, machine learning and artificial intelligence, for the modelling and analysis of all kinds of biological data, as well as systems biology.

science.name: Science
science.full_name: Science - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science.description: Peer-reviewed flagship journal of the American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS), publishing significant original research across all scientific disciplines along with news and commentary.

science_advances.name: Science Advances
science_advances.full_name: Science Advances - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_advances.description: AAAS open-access multidisciplinary journal publishing peer-reviewed original research across the physical, life, social, and computer sciences and engineering.

science_immunology.name: Science Immunology
science_immunology.full_name: Science Immunology - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_immunology.description: AAAS journal publishing peer-reviewed original research across immunology in all organisms and model systems, spanning molecular, cellular, and translational immunology.

science_robotics.name: Science Robotics
science_robotics.full_name: Science Robotics - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_robotics.description: AAAS journal publishing peer-reviewed original research on advances in robotics and related disciplines, including robot design, control, autonomy, and applications.

science_signaling.name: Science Signaling
science_signaling.full_name: Science Signaling - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_signaling.description: AAAS journal publishing peer-reviewed original research on cellular signaling and regulatory networks, including signal transduction, systems biology, and relevance to disease.

science_translational_medicine.name: Science Translational Medicine
science_translational_medicine.full_name: Science Translational Medicine - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_translational_medicine.description: AAAS journal publishing peer-reviewed original research that bridges basic science and clinical medicine to advance human health.

aaai_2027.name: AAAI 2027
aaai_2027.full_name: The Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence
aaai_2027.description: Promote research in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and foster scientific exchange between researchers, practitioners, scientists, students, and engineers across the entirety of AI and its affiliated disciplines.

iclr_2027.name: ICLR 2027
iclr_2027.full_name: The Fifteenth International Conference on Learning Representations
iclr_2027.description: Conference on representation learning, deep learning, and their applications, covering machine learning theory, methods, and practice.

discrete_mathematics.name: Discrete Mathematics
discrete_mathematics.description: Elsevier journal publishing original research and survey articles across combinatorics, graph theory, and the broader field of discrete mathematics.

combinatorica.name: Combinatorica
combinatorica.description: International journal publishing research in combinatorics and the theory of computing, including combinatorial structures, optimization, algorithms, complexity, geometry, and number theory.

acl_arr.name: ACL Rolling Review
acl_arr.description: Centralized, rolling peer-review service for the ACL community, feeding reviewed NLP and computational linguistics papers to *ACL conferences.

aistats_2027.name: AISTATS 2027
aistats_2027.full_name: The 30th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics
aistats_2027.description: Conference at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and statistics.

ajhg.name: AJHG
ajhg.full_name: The American Journal of Human Genetics (Cell Press)
ajhg.description: Official journal of the American Society of Human Genetics, publishing research and perspectives across human genetics and genomics.

bmj.name: The BMJ
bmj.description: Weekly general medical journal publishing original research, analysis, education and commentary for an international readership of clinicians and policy makers.

cell_reports.name: Cell Reports
cell_reports.description: Open-access Cell Press journal publishing high-quality life-science research across the full spectrum of biology, with a focus on shorter single-point Reports as well as longer Research Articles and Resources.

cvpr_2027.name: CVPR 2027
cvpr_2027.full_name: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2027
cvpr_2027.description: Premier conference on computer vision and pattern recognition, covering 3D vision, deep learning, generative models, embodied vision, autonomous driving, and medical and biological vision.

elife.name: eLife
elife.description: Open-access journal publishing significant research across the life sciences and medicine as Reviewed Preprints with public reviews and an eLife assessment.

european_radiology.name: European Radiology
european_radiology.description: Official journal of the European Society of Radiology publishing original research, reviews, technical developments, and guidelines across all areas of diagnostic and interventional radiology.

genome_medicine.name: Genome Medicine
genome_medicine.description: Open access journal publishing research on the application of genetics, genomics and multi-omics to understand, diagnose and treat disease.

genome_research.name: Genome Research
genome_research.full_name: Genome Research (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press)
genome_research.description: Publishes research on genome structure and function, comparative genomics, molecular evolution, genome-scale quantitative and population genetics, epigenomics, systems biology, and computational and high-throughput methods.

ieee_tmi.name: IEEE TMI
ieee_tmi.description: Publishes original research on the science and engineering of medical imaging, including image formation, reconstruction, analysis, and computational methods across imaging modalities.

ieee_tnnls.name: IEEE TNNLS
ieee_tnnls.full_name: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
ieee_tnnls.description: IEEE Computational Intelligence Society journal on the theory, design, and applications of neural networks and related learning systems, reviewed double-anonymously.

ieee_tpami.name: IEEE TPAMI
ieee_tpami.full_name: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
ieee_tpami.description: IEEE Computer Society journal covering computer vision, pattern analysis and recognition, and machine intelligence with an emphasis on machine learning for pattern analysis.

jama.name: JAMA
jama.full_name: JAMA: The Journal of the American Medical Association
jama.description: Weekly general medical journal of the American Medical Association publishing original investigations, research letters, reviews and commentary.

jmlr.name: JMLR
jmlr.description: Open-access journal publishing theory and methods of machine learning; applications of ML to other domains are out of scope.

jnm.name: JNM
jnm.description: Official journal of the Society of Nuclear Medicine and Molecular Imaging publishing original laboratory and clinical investigations in nuclear medicine and molecular imaging.

lancet.name: The Lancet
lancet.description: Weekly international general medical journal publishing original research likely to change clinical practice, plus reviews, commentary and correspondence.

lancet_digital_health.name: Lancet Digital Health
lancet_digital_health.description: Publishes original research, reviews, and commentary on digital health, including AI, mobile health, telemedicine, wearables, health informatics, and digital therapeutics.

medical_image_analysis.name: Medical Image Analysis
medical_image_analysis.description: Official journal of the MICCAI Society publishing original research on the analysis and use of biomedical images, including segmentation, registration, computer-aided diagnosis, and image-guided intervention.

nature_biomedical_engineering.name: Nature Biomedical Engineering
nature_biomedical_engineering.description: Publishes original research and commissioned content at the interface of engineering and the biomedical and clinical sciences, including biomaterials, devices, imaging, computational methods and therapeutic technologies.

nature_communications.name: Nature Communications
nature_communications.description: Open access journal publishing high-quality original research from all areas of the natural sciences, presenting important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

nature_genetics.name: Nature Genetics
nature_genetics.description: Publishes research of broad interest across all areas of genetics and genomics, including human, model-organism, plant and cancer genetics, and functional and population genomics.

nature_machine_intelligence.name: Nature Machine Intelligence
nature_machine_intelligence.description: Publishes original research and commentary on machine learning, robotics and AI and their applications across the sciences, including methods, analyses and reusability reports.

nature_medicine.name: Nature Medicine
nature_medicine.description: Publishes original peer-reviewed research in all areas of medicine, with emphasis on translational and clinical research, on the basis of originality, timeliness, interdisciplinary interest and impact on human health.

nejm.name: NEJM
nejm.full_name: The New England Journal of Medicine
nejm.description: Weekly general medical journal publishing original clinical research, reviews, case reports and commentary of importance to clinical practice.

neuron.name: Neuron
neuron.description: Cell Press journal publishing research across neuroscience, from molecular and cellular to systems, cognitive and disease-related studies.

npj_digital_medicine.name: npj Digital Medicine
npj_digital_medicine.description: Open access Nature Portfolio journal publishing research on digital medicine, including AI, wearables, telehealth, health data, and clinical informatics.

pnas.name: PNAS
pnas.full_name: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
pnas.description: Multidisciplinary journal of the US National Academy of Sciences publishing original research of exceptional importance across the biological, physical, and social sciences.

radiology.name: Radiology
radiology.description: Peer-reviewed journal of the Radiological Society of North America publishing original research, reviews, and commentary across diagnostic radiology and imaging; uses double-anonymized review.

radiology_ai.name: Radiology: Artificial Intelligence
radiology_ai.description: RSNA journal on applications of machine learning and artificial intelligence in medical imaging, including original research, technical developments, data resources, and reviews; uses double-anonymized review.

tmlr.name: TMLR
tmlr.description: Open-access, double-blind journal for machine learning research reviewed on OpenReview, with acceptance based on correctness and claim support rather than novelty.
